events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: A Legend Turns 87
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Fawlty Towers' to 'Monty Python', his comedic genius has left an indelible mark on British humour. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album'. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His unparalleled stage presence and vocal talent continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 59 years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. Which track still holds up for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist and advocate for peace, 46 years after his passing. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: David Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, on what would have been his 80th birthday. His incredible artistry and fearless innovation continue to inspire. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His impact on music is simply unmatched. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs changed rock music forever. What's your favourite Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! With a career spanning decades, his distinctive voice is still unmistakable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs' Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! His voice has soundtracked countless good times. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation. What's your favourite track from the '80s pop icon?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true living legend whose music and spirit shine bright. What's your go-to Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, he's given us so many unforgettable songs. What's your favourite?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! His timeless hits still get us dancing. Which one is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, honouring pioneers of the genre. Which artist do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! A key part of Take That's enduring success. What's your favourite song featuring Mark?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: 58 years ago today, The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert in London. What an iconic final live performance!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins' Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A drumming legend and hitmaker. What's your favourite Phil Collins or Genesis track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Hugh Grant's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to more dramatic turns, he's a true British screen icon. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband sensation to solo superstar, he's still bringing the hits. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Sir David Jason's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television. What's your favourite character he's played?
